concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-business-accounts-how-sca-works]] — 2022-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Business Accounts API SCA overview for SDK eligibility, HTTP 401 challenge exchange and endpoint-specific HTTP 2xx finalization; its authenticate-user section uses device-registration calls, so setup is not proof of per-action authentication or funds movement.
warnings: The raw Authenticate your user section uses register(...) device-registration methods; avoid treating registration as successful authentication of a later API procedure.
